proof_audit.independent_reasoning: The observed target/control change contrast equals ATT plus a difference of untreated changes only after the target baseline and both control outcomes are unaffected. Add/subtract the target untreated post mean. Conditional equality is integrated over the treated covariate distribution, not the comparison distribution.
proof_audit.conditions_and_limits: Consistency, no interference, absorbing adoption, fixed population/measurement and clean support are substantive. No randomized adoption follows from iid sampling.

proof_audit.independent_reasoning: Conditional expansion leaves (p−p_tilde)(m0−m_tilde)/(1−p_tilde), divided by true pi. Either correct nuisance annihilates the remainder. True odds have mass pi; false odds need not. A separate peer transfer using constant candidate probability 1/3 produces 21/4 with actual pi versus 9/2 after separate comparison normalization.
proof_audit.conditions_and_limits: This identity alone supplies no nuisance-learning rate, cross-fitting theorem or inference under arbitrary normalization.

proof_audit.independent_reasoning: The finite vector of cell frequencies and change totals has an iid finite-second-moment CLT. Positive group-cell probabilities give a differentiable ratio functional. I independently differentiated this empirical functional with exact rational dual numbers in all eight contamination directions, obtaining the full stated influence. Its multinomial covariance is 49/6; the three orthogonal components are 3/2, 2 and 14/3. Finite-cell LLNs for counts, changes and squared changes justify the plug-in meat.
proof_audit.conditions_and_limits: The treated-cell shares are estimated. Empty group cells make the displayed estimator unavailable; the finite union of exponentially decreasing missing-cell probabilities justifies an auxiliary asymptotic definition, not imputation. V/N, positive V and independent whole units are essential.

proof_audit.topic: TWFE projection and exact comparison decomposition
proof_audit.independent_reasoning: I constructed three group and three normalized date columns, then projected treatment using rational Gram–Schmidt, obtaining the full 12-cell residual and coefficient operator. Solving for the four contrast weights and reconstructing all twelve operator entries proves the fixed-design all-table identity. Under additive untreated means, only treated effects remain; their weights sum to one but include −1/10.
proof_audit.conditions_and_limits: This is a proved equal-cell finite design. It is not a general Bacon decomposition proof or a causal interpretation under arbitrary untreated paths. Positive comparison weights do not make an already-treated control clean.

proof_audit.independent_reasoning: I constructed all eleven columns for every one of the twelve cohort/date rows, including impact zero and both leads. Exact orthogonalization gives the full coefficient operator; its last five rows match all sixty visible entries. The residual event Gram, cross-products, Gram–Schmidt norms, determinant 1/54 and action on all eleven columns agree. The resulting leads depend on the impact-effect difference, despite zero anticipation and untreated trends.
proof_audit.conditions_and_limits: Changing omitted categories, bins, weighting or support changes the operator. Finite design algebra supplies no cluster sampling law.

proof_audit.independent_reasoning: Supported impact averages use E and L, while event one uses only E. Fixed-E and changing-cohort contrasts are different estimands. Replacing every E post effect by one leaves both cohort effects constant but changes the moving-composition average from 3/2 to one.
proof_audit.conditions_and_limits: Unsupported L event one is not zero; a fixed-cohort target requires support for that cohort at every compared horizon.

proof_audit.independent_reasoning: The assumption gives clean dates s<g−a. Thus b=g−a−1 and comparison G>t+a suffice at both dates for t≥g. The baseline-2 and adoption-4 comparisons each yield 3 instead of 5 in the explicit case. I checked the strict G=4/G=5 boundary and a genuinely known future date beyond the observation window.
proof_audit.conditions_and_limits: Nonadoption observed only through T cannot establish G>T+a; no baseline or no eligible control means unavailable identification by this contrast.

proof_audit.independent_reasoning: Zero preperiod gaps and observed post gap four admit untreated post gaps zero or three, with effects four or one. For every permitted departure path, setting control means to zero, target untreated means to departures and observed target means to the specified reduced form constructs a compatible potential-outcome law.
proof_audit.conditions_and_limits: No outcome bounds or effect-sign restrictions are silently imposed. Nonempty compact convex fibers attain a full closed interval; closed convexity alone is not a general attainment theorem.

proof_audit.independent_reasoning: Independent intersections of half-plane boundaries in (delta1,delta2) recover both sets. Relative constraints are |delta1|≤Mbar and |delta2−delta1|≤Mbar; curvature constraints are |delta1−1|≤M and |delta2−2delta1|≤M. Projecting the resulting vertices gives centers/radii 5±3Mbar/2 and 7/2±2M. Convex departure paths provide all intermediate target values and explicit compatible outcomes.
proof_audit.conditions_and_limits: The parameters have different units and scientific meanings. Zero relative radius gives departure zero; zero curvature continues the prior slope. A zero preincrement scale collapses the relative set even at positive Mbar. Empty constraint fibers remain empty.

proof_audit.topic: Gaussian simultaneous projection and arbitrary correlation
proof_audit.independent_reasoning: Under the stipulated known Gaussian marginals, z=Phi inverse(1−alpha/4) gives each coordinate failure alpha/2. The union bound therefore gives simultaneous coverage at least 1−alpha for arbitrary correlation, including singular endpoints. If the means lie in the rectangle, every true admissible departure is among the projected triples, proving coverage of the true target.
proof_audit.conditions_and_limits: This is finite inference under an assumed exact Gaussian law, not a generic DID or uniform asymptotic theorem. Both pre and post uncertainty matter. Unknown marginal scales would require another argument.

proof_audit.topic: Nonconvex compatible triples and interval witness
proof_audit.independent_reasoning: The constraints |delta|≤Mbar|bpre| need not form a convex joint set. Two compatible triples with bpre=±1 and delta=1 have an incompatible midpoint. Fix a pre endpoint of greatest absolute value; varying the independent post interval and departure interval then fills the complete target interval. I checked endpoints and interior witnesses for boxes crossing zero, wholly positive, wholly negative and degenerate, and for Mbar=0.
proof_audit.conditions_and_limits: Interval shape is established directly by a witness, not falsely inferred from joint convexity. The symbolic Gaussian endpoints define coverage; rounded decimals are only illustrations.

exercise_audit.exact_prompt: A report pools regions with staggered adoption, bins several leads, sees an insignificant joint lead test, uses all not-yet-adopted regions despite a documented one-period anticipation window, and interprets its TWFE coefficient as an equally weighted ATT. It chooses a sensitivity bound after seeing the estimate and labels a plug-in identified interval a 95% confidence interval. Give six distinct objections, two feasible repairs with explicit remaining assumptions, and a defensible conclusion. The solution rubric allocates 12 points.
exercise_audit.independent_solution_and_conclusion: Six distinct objections address unsupported future trends/pretest logic, heterogeneous/binned lead meanings, TWFE effect weights, anticipation contamination, post-result sensitivity choices and the distinction between identification and confidence intervals. A first repair declares supported cohort/horizon targets and clean comparisons with counterfactual-trend assumptions. A second justifies sensitivity values and a sampling law with both coordinate uncertainties. The report currently identifies a regression association, not its claimed equal-weight ATT or 95% procedure.
exercise_audit.evidence: The open rubric reconciles six one-point critiques, two two-point repairs and a two-point conclusion; other reasoned repairs remain admissible.
exercise_audit.status: Full exact prompt and complete supplied solution read; independently solved; no material finding.

Equal cohort impacts remove both spurious event leads; other heterogeneous effects change all coefficients by the full design operator.
Group and calendar offsets leave the event coefficients unchanged.
Constant within-cohort effects still change a moving-composition event aggregate.
Control first-adoption dates4 and5 straddle the strict eligibility boundary; known future date6 differs from unknown future status.
Sensitivity amounts0,1/2 and1 use distinct restriction families; zero preincrement magnitude and negative continuing slope exercise separate boundaries.

Two individually compatible premean/departure triples have an incompatible midpoint, disproving the unnecessary joint-convexity claim.
